Why are soldiers attaching nets and plastic bottles to their guns? From specialized brass catchers used by the Japanese military to improvised plastic bottles taped onto rifles, these strange-looking devices have been appearing on social media! Their purpose? Catching spent shell casings, saving cleanup time, and keeping valuable brass from disappearing!
